messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the reliability incident. I've uploaded the RCA and an action table. Please review and claim owners. RCA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4408
ops-bot: Incident INC-4408 created. Postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4408
Carlos: I can take the rollout checklist and infra verification. Will update the table by EOD.
Evan: I'll pick up runtime perf checks and KV cache traces. Will add any kernel anomalies into the table.
Nina: Product question: any user-facing changes we should call out in release notes or customer comms? Also is canary plan safe to run as-is?
Priya: Short-term config guard fixes the immediate failure mode (eviction + batch edge). Canary will include the guard. Long-term: runtime kernel change. We'll include a blurb in release notes.
Nina: Ok, I'll prep release note blurb once Carlos posts the tech summary.
oncall: Hotfix canary scheduled: 2026-04-05T22:00:00Z. Full rollout target: 2026-04-06T04:00:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hf-4408
Carlos: Requesting temporary access to 2 extra GPU nodes for repeatable perf runs. Priya, can you approve?
Priya: Approved for up to 48h. Ops, please tag resources with INC-4408.
ops-bot: Resources allocated and tagged: inc-4408-test-01, inc-4408-test-02. Monitoring in place.
Evan: Starting perf runs in ~20m and will post a short summary here.
Priya: I've added the deploy times and runbook link to the action table. Please add a short status note when you start/complete items.
Nina: CS note: two Dedicated customers reported errors during the incident window (AcmeCorp, BlueWave). Who owns customer outreach? I can draft comms if someone provides the technical paragraph.
Carlos: I'll write the tech paragraph and hand it to Nina for tone. Target: internal draft in 4h, customer-ready in 10h.
Evan: Adding action list to the table: - Perf checks: Evan (24h) - Kernel traces: Evan (36h) - Infra verification: Carlos (48h) - Canary with guard: Ops (scheduled) - Customer comms tech blurb: Carlos -> Nina (10h) - Post-canary QA: Priya/Product (72h)
Priya: Thanks. I'll consolidate owners into a one-pager for tomorrow's follow-up sync. Expect an update in ~6 hours. :thumbsup:
Nina: Product will pause promos for affected endpoints during canary to avoid metric noise.
Carlos: Marking owners in the action table now. :white_check_mark:
Evan: First perf summary: no regression at 95th pctl on the guarded config; will post detailed logs to the RCA doc in 2h.
Priya: Great. Please react with :eyes: once you've updated the table. File with actions/links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RCAs/pages/INC-4408-actions
Nina: Thanks team. I'll coordinate customer outreach after tech blurb is ready.
Priya: End of thread for now 12"
